questions.question_text: Why is identifying your values, strengths, and passions important when building an online presence?

options.text: It helps you copy popular trends online
It forms the foundation of your personal brand and guides what you share
It guarantees you’ll get more followers instantly
It’s only necessary for professional platforms like LinkedIn

correct_answer.text: It forms the foundation of your personal brand and guides what you share

questions.question_text: What is an online persona, and how should it relate to who you are?

options.text: It’s a completely made-up character you pretend to be online
It’s the version of yourself you show online, and it should be authentic to your real personality
It’s only about looking perfect and professional for everyone to like you
It’s something you change every day based on trends

correct_answer.text: It’s the version of yourself you show online, and it should be authentic to your real personality

questions.question_text: How should teens choose the right platforms for self-expression?

options.text: By joining every platform to reach the most people
By picking platforms that match their goals, persona, and the type of content they want to share
By only using the most popular platform among their friends
By avoiding platforms like LinkedIn since they’re only for adults

correct_answer.text: By picking platforms that match their goals, persona, and the type of content they want to share

questions.question_text: What does it mean to create consistent and authentic content for your online presence?

options.text: Posting random things every day to stay active
Sharing content that follows a similar style or theme and reflects your true self, not a fake version
Only posting polished, perfect photos to impress others
Copying what popular influencers post to gain followers

correct_answer.text: Sharing content that follows a similar style or theme and reflects your true self, not a fake version
